name: Giant Squid — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Giant Squid from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Squid, Giant (Mythic)" but are not part of the Giant Squid entry, which is unchanged.

hp 134 (12d8+80)
Fort +14 Ref +13 Will +5
Defensive Abilities deep dweller, ink cloud (20-ft. radius) ; DR 10/epic; Resist cold 20

OFFENSE

Speed swim 60 ft., jet 260 ft.
Melee bite +16 (2d6+9), 2 arms +16 (1d6+9), tentacles +14 (4d6+13/19-20/x3 plus grab)

Skills Perception +22, Swim +17

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Deep Dweller (Ex)

A mythic giant squid is immune to damage from water pressure and is highly resistant to cold due to their long ages spent in the chill pelagic depths. Unlike their lesser cousins, their bodies can adjust instantly to the pressure at different water depths or even the surface with ease. Their enormous eyes gain darkvision with a range of 300 feet when they are underwater; this darkvision does not extent above the water’s surface.

Gnawing Grapple (Ex)
